camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --CustomType custom --SourceIp '1.2.X.X' --Lang zh --StrategyIds 8164248
description_en: Queries the details about baseline check policies
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-strategy --source-ip 1.2.X.X --lang zh --strategy-ids 8164248 --custom-type custom --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeStrategy

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the baseline check policy that you want to query. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的策略的ID。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the baseline check policy that you want to query. Valid values:

common: standard baseline check policy
custom: custom baseline check policy
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的策略的类型。取值：

common：标准策略
custom：自定义策略
parameters.name: custom_type

schema.description_zh: 基线检查策略返回信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Strategies.description_en: The details of the baseline check policies

items.description_en: The details of the baseline check policy

ConfigTargets.description_en: The details of the assets to which the baseline check policy is applied
ConfigTargets.description_zh: 策略生效资产的信息集合

items.description_en: The asset to which the baseline check policy is applied

Flag.description_en:
Indicates whether the baseline check policy is applied to the asset group. Valid values:

add: The baseline check policy is applied to the asset group.
del: the baseline check policy is not applied to the asset group
Flag.description_zh:
策略是否对该资产分组生效。取值：

add：对该资产分组生效
del：不对该资产分组生效

Target.description_en: The asset group ID or UUID of the asset to which the baseline check policy is applied
Target.description_zh: 策略生效的资产的分组ID或者UUID

TargetType.description_en:
The condition by which the baseline check policy is applied to the asset. Valid values:

groupId: the ID of the asset group
uuid: the UUID of the asset
TargetType.description_zh:
策略生效资产的添加方式。取值：

groupId：按照资产的分组添加。
uuid：按照单个资产添加

CustomType.description_en:
The type of the baseline check policy. Valid values:

common
custom
CustomType.description_zh:
策略的类型。取值：

common：标准策略
custom：自定义策略

CycleDays.description_en:
The cycle of the baseline check. Valid values:

1: every 2 days
3: every 4 days
7: every 8 days
30: every 31 days
CycleDays.description_zh:
基线检查的周期。取值：

1：每隔1天
3：每隔3天
7：每隔7天
30：每隔30天

CycleStartTime.description_en:
The time when the baseline check starts. Valid values:

0: The baseline check starts within the time range from 00:00 to 06:00.
6: The baseline check starts within the time range from 06:00 to 12:00.
12: The baseline check starts within the time range from 12:00 to 18:00.
18: The baseline check starts within the time range from 18:00 to 24:00
CycleStartTime.description_zh:
基线检查开始的时间。取值：

0：表示基线检查开始的时间为0:00~6:00
6：表示基线检查开始的时间为6:00~12:00
12：表示基线检查开始的时间为12:00~18:00
18：表示基线检查开始的时间为18:00~24:00

EcsCount.description_en: The number of the assets to which the baseline check policy is applied
EcsCount.description_zh: 策略生效的资产的数量

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the baseline check policy
EndTime.description_zh: 基线检查策略执行结束时间

ExecStatus.description_en:
The status of the baseline check policy. Valid values:

1: not executed
2: executing
ExecStatus.description_zh:
基线检查策略的执行状态。取值：

1：未执行
2：执行中

ExecutionType.description_en:
The triggering method of baseline scanning. Value:

Schedule : Periodic configuration of task triggers

Manual : Manually triggered
ExecutionType.description_zh:
基线扫描的触发方式。取值：

Schedule：周期性配置任务触发
Manual：手动触发

Id.description_en: The ID of the baseline check policy

Name.description_en: The name of the baseline check policy

PassRate.description_en: The proportion of risky baselines in the baseline check result
PassRate.description_zh: 执行基线检查策略发现的存在风险的基线的占比

Percent.description_en: The progress of the baseline check by using the baseline. This parameter is returned only if the value of the ExecStatus parameter is 2
Percent.description_zh: 检查中基线的检查进度，仅ExecStatus = 2的基线会返回该参数

ProcessRate.description_en: The number of the assets on which the baseline check is complete
ProcessRate.description_zh: 已完成基线检查的资产的数量

RiskCount.description_en: The number of baseline check items in the baseline check policy
RiskCount.description_zh: 策略包含的基线检查项的数量

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the baseline check policy
StartTime.description_zh: 基线检查策略执行开始时间

Type.description_en:
The source type of the baseline check policy. Valid values:

1: indicates a built-in policy provided and performed by Security Center by default.
2: indicates a user-defined policy. It can be a standard or custom baseline check policy
Type.description_zh:
策略的来源类型。取值：

1：系统自带的策略，即云安全中心默认执行的基线检查策略。
2：用户添加的策略，包括用户自定义创建的标准策略和自定义策略

UserModifyTime.description_en: The time when the baseline check policy was last modified
UserModifyTime.description_zh: 基线检测策略的上次修改时间
